headline: Jeena Sikho Lifecare board approves proposed incorporation of a subsidiary
hook: New subsidiary planned by Jeena Sikho
summary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited announced that its board of directors met on November 04, 2026, and approved the proposed incorporation of a new subsidiary company. The exchange filing provides formal notice of this corporate expansion decision. Retail investors should track future filings for details on the subsidiary's business focus and capital allocation.
whats_next: Exchange disclosures on subsidiary incorporation details
why_it_matters: Subsidiary expansion could alter future capital allocation and business scope.

headline: Jeena Sikho Lifecare allots 23,374 equity shares under ESOS 2024
summary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has announced the allotment of 23,374 equity shares pursuant to its Employee Stock Option Scheme 2024. This corporate action marginally expands the company's total paid-up equity base. Routine ESOS allotments have a negligible direct impact on retail investors' near-term portfolio value.
why_it_matters: Minor equity dilution from employee stock options.
